recipes.title: Track demo: night phonk
recipes.intent: A 2:29 night phonk track: deep lead and counter-melody, hazy pad, 808 with glide and ducking, trap drums with rolls, cowbell, risers and impacts, vox textures, glue bus.
recipes.code:
// Night phonk demo: G minor, VI-i-VII-VI, half-time feel on a 128.8 bpm grid, 80 bars = 2:29
// intro 1-8 | build 9-16 | drop 17-32 | breakdown 33-40 | build 2 41-48 | drop 2 49-72 | outro 73-80
setcpm(128.8 / 4)
await voxBank('ljspeech'); await voxBank('sung'); await voxBank('call-me-baby'); await voxBank('vocalset')

// == glyphcore/phonk: atoms (harmony, lines, rhythms, gates) ==
atom("ph.chords", { type: "mini", body: "<[eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [g3,bb3,d4,f4] [f3,a3,c4,eb4] [eb3,g3,bb3,d4]>" })
atom("ph.sub", { type: "mini", body: "<[eb1@7 eb1@3 eb1@6] [f1@7 g1@3 g1@6] [f1@7 f1@3 f1@6] [eb1@7 eb1@3 bb0@6]>" })
atom("ph.glide", { type: "mini", body: "<0 [0 -2 0] 0 [0 0 5]>" })
atom("ph.lead", { type: "mini", body: "<[~@4 g4@4 bb4@3 d5@2 a4@3] [a4@8 ~@4 bb4 c5@2 a4] [g4@6 ~@2 f4@2 g4@2 bb4@4] [bb4@6 a4@4 g4@6]>" })
atom("ph.counter", { type: "mini", body: "<[d4@8 c4@4 bb3@4] [~@10 f4@2 eb4@2 d4@2] [c4@8 bb3@4 a3@4] [~@8 g3@8]>" })
atom("ph.bell", { type: "mini", body: "<[g5 ~ ~ g5 ~ ~ bb5 ~ g5 ~ ~ d5 ~ f5 ~ ~] [g5 ~ ~ g5 ~ ~ a5 ~ f5 ~ ~ d5 ~ eb5 ~ ~]>" })
atom("ph.kick", { type: "mini", body: "<[x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]!3 [x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x x]>" })
atom("ph.snare", { type: "mini", body: "~ ~ x ~" })
atom("ph.ghost", { type: "mini", body: "~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ x" })
atom("ph.hats", { type: "mini", body: "<x*16!3 [x x x x x x x x [x x x]*4 x x x x]>" })
atom("ph.accent", { type: "mini", body: "[1 .45 .7 .45]*4" })
atom("ph.roll", { type: "mini", body: "x*16" })
atom("ph.every4", { type: "mini", body: "<x ~ ~ ~>/4" })
atom("ph.lastBar", { type: "mini", body: "<~ ~ ~ x>" })
atom("ph.noDrums", { type: "gate", body: "<9b, 33b..41b, 77b.." })
atom("ph.noLow", { type: "gate", body: "<17b, 33b..49b, 75b.." })
atom("ph.noDrop", { type: "gate", body: "<17b, 33b..49b, 73b.." })
atom("ph.noRoll", { type: "gate", body: "<15b, 17b..47b, 49b.." })
atom("ph.noRise", { type: "gate", body: "<13b, 17b..45b, 49b.." })
atom("ph.dark", { type: "gate", body: "<9b, 33b..41b, 73b.." })
atom("ph.builds", { type: "gate", body: "9b..17b, 41b..49b" })
atom("ph.drop2", { type: "gate", body: "49b..73b" })

// == glyphcore/phonk: racks (instrument rigs as hook defs) ==
hooks.def("kick808", { chain: [["s", "sine"], ["freq", 55], ["penv", 36], ["pdecay", 0.04], ["decay", 0.28], ["sustain", 0], ["noise", 0.12], ["shape", 0.4], ["gain", 0.8]] })
hooks.def("snareNoise", { chain: [["s", "triangle"], ["note", "d3"], ["noise", 0.85], ["decay", 0.19], ["sustain", 0], ["hpf", 170], ["gain", 0.9]] })
hooks.def("hat", { params: { len: { min: 0.01, max: 0.2, default: 0.05 } }, chain: [["s", "white"], ["hpf", 7000], ["decay", { $param: "len" }], ["sustain", 0], ["gain", 0.45]] })
hooks.def("cowbell", { chain: [["s", "square"], ["bpf", 1300], ["bpq", 2.5], ["decay", 0.17], ["sustain", 0], ["gain", 0.28]] })
hooks.def("sub808", { chain: [["s", "sine"], ["pdecay", 0.14], ["decay", 0.6], ["sustain", 0.7], ["release", 0.1], ["shape", 0.45], ["lpf", 600], ["gain", 0.45]] })
hooks.def("hazePad", { params: { cut: { min: 200, max: 5000, default: 1400 } }, chain: [["s", "supersaw"], ["unison", 4], ["detune", 0.22], ["attack", 0.8], ["sustain", 0.8], ["release", 2.5], ["lpf", { $param: "cut" }], ["lpenv", 1.5], ["lpattack", 1.6], ["gain", 0.2]] })
hooks.def("deepLead", { chain: [["s", "sawtooth"], ["lpf", 1900], ["lpenv", 1], ["lpdecay", 0.25], ["attack", 0.012], ["sustain", 0.6], ["release", 0.35], ["vib", 5], ["vibmod", 0.1], ["gain", 0.38]] })
hooks.def("wideLead", { chain: [["s", { $mini: "sawtooth, square" }], ["lpf", 2600], ["lpenv", 1], ["attack", 0.012], ["sustain", 0.6], ["release", 0.4], ["vib", 5], ["vibmod", 0.1], ["gain", 0.27]] })
hooks.def("echoPluck", { chain: [["s", "triangle"], ["decay", 0.25], ["sustain", 0.2], ["release", 0.3], ["delay", 0.35], ["delaytime", 0.349], ["delayfeedback", 0.45], ["gain", 0.4]] })
hooks.def("formant", { chain: [["attack", 0.6], ["release", 1.5], ["vowel", "o"], ["lpf", 2400], ["gain", 0.36]] })
hooks.def("chop", { chain: [["end", 0.3], ["hpf", 300], ["lpf", 3500], ["gain", 0.32]] })
hooks.def("riser", { chain: [["s", "white"], ["attack", 6], ["release", 0.3], ["hpf", 300], ["lpf", 900], ["lpenv", 4], ["lpattack", 7], ["gain", 0.3]] })
hooks.def("reverseHit", { chain: [["s", "white"], ["attack", 1.7], ["sustain", 1], ["release", 0.02], ["hpf", 2500], ["gain", 0.3]] })
hooks.def("impact", { chain: [["s", "sine"], ["note", "c1"], ["penv", 30], ["pdecay", 0.2], ["decay", 2.5], ["sustain", 0], ["noise", 0.25], ["gain", 0.7]] })
hooks.def("tape", { chain: [["hpf", 3500], ["gain", 0.05]] })
// shared moves: filter state, drive, duck to the kick
hooks.def("murk", { chain: [["lpf", { $mini: "<500 600 750 900 750 600>" }]] })
hooks.def("thin", { params: { hz: { min: 100, max: 2000, default: 450 } }, chain: [["hpf", { $param: "hz" }]] })
hooks.def("grit", { params: { amt: { min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 } }, chain: [["shape", { $param: "amt" }]] })
hooks.def("pump", { params: { depth: { min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.6 } }, chain: [["wire", "gain", "kick:env", { range: [1, { $expr: "1-depth" }], op: "mul", r: 0.18 }]] })

// == track: racks into slots, gated moves ==
hooks.bind("kick", "kick808"); hooks.bind("snare", "snareNoise"); hooks.bind("hat", "hat"); hooks.bind("bell", "cowbell")
hooks.bind("sub", "sub808"); hooks.bind("pad", "hazePad"); hooks.bind("ctr", "echoPluck"); hooks.bind("rise", "riser")
hooks.bind("rev", "reverseHit"); hooks.bind("hit", "impact"); hooks.bind("vox", "chop"); hooks.bind("voxpad", "formant"); hooks.bind("tex", "tape")
hooks.slot("lead", { mode: "swap" }); hooks.bind("lead", "deepLead"); hooks.bind("lead", "wideLead", atoms.ph.drop2, { priority: 1 })
hooks.bind("tone", "murk", atoms.ph.dark); hooks.bind("tone", "thin", atoms.ph.builds); hooks.bind("drive", "grit(0.55)", atoms.ph.drop2); hooks.bind("duck", "pump")

// == macros ==
ctl("macro", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 1 }); ctl("space", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 })
ctl("grit", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 }); ctl("energy", { type: "knob", min: 0, max: 1, default: 0.5 })
hooks.map("macro", "lpf", { range: [0.1, 1], curve: "exp", op: "mul" }); hooks.map("space", "room", { range: [0, 2], op: "mul" })
hooks.map("grit", "shape", { range: [0, 2], op: "mul" }); hooks.map("energy", "velocity", { range: [0.6, 1.4], op: "mul" })

// == lanes ==
kick: s(atoms.ph.kick).use("kick").velocity(1).tap("kick", { export: true }).tags("drums", "low")
snare: s(atoms.ph.snare).use("snare").velocity(1).room(0.25).tags("drums")
ghost: s(atoms.ph.ghost).use("snare").velocity(0.22).tags("drums")
roll: s(atoms.ph.roll).use("snare").velocity(saw.range(0.25, 1).slow(2)).tags("drums", "roll")
hats: s(atoms.ph.hats).use("hat").velocity(atoms.ph.accent).nudge(rand.range(0, 0.006)).swingBy(0.06, 8).use("duck").tags("drums")
bell: note(atoms.ph.bell).add(note("0,6.8")).use("bell").use("duck").velocity(1).room(0.3).tags("bell", "wet")
sub: note(atoms.ph.sub).penv(atoms.ph.glide).use("sub").use("drive").orbit(3).tags("low")
pad: note(atoms.ph.chords).use("pad").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(900, 1800)).use("tone").pan(0.5).orbit(4).tags("harm", "wet")
lead: note(atoms.ph.lead).use("lead").use("tone").use("drive").room(0.3).tags("melody", "wet")
ctr: note(atoms.ph.counter).use("ctr").use("tone").use("duck").orbit(6).tags("melody", "counter", "wet")
voxpad: s("<vs_o_pp vs_a_pp>/2").note("<g4 d4>/2").use("voxpad").orbit(4).tags("vox", "wet")
chop: word("<ay ee>").struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ x").use("vox").use("duck").tags("vox", "wet", "chop")
swell: stack(word("air").struct(atoms.ph.lastBar).attack(0.45).release(0.05).speed(0.8).hpf(500).gain(0.3),
  word("breath").note("d#4").struct("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ x]>").gain(0.25)).tags("vox", "fx", "wet") // one lane for both: as two lanes they raise AudioNode errors on the site (#92)
rise: s(atoms.ph.every4).use("rise").tags("fx", "rise")
rev: s(atoms.ph.lastBar).use("rev").tags("fx", "rise")
hit: s(atoms.ph.every4).slow(4).use("hit").room(0.4).tags("fx", "hit")
tex: s("pink, brown").use("tex").tags("tex")
crackle: s("white*8").degradeBy(0.6).attack(0.002).decay(0.015).sustain(0).hpf(2500).gain(rand.range(0.02, 0.07)).tags("tex")
verb: ret("verb").room(1).rsize(5).hpf(200).lpf(5000).orbit(8)
glue: ret("glue").compressor("-24:4:6:.01:.15").gain(0.5).orbit(9)

// == arrangement and mix: selections, not copies ==
tagged("drums").mute(atoms.ph.noDrums); tagged("low").mute(atoms.ph.noLow); tagged("bell | counter | chop").mute(atoms.ph.noDrop)
tagged("roll").mute(atoms.ph.noRoll); tagged("rise").mute(atoms.ph.noRise); tagged("hit").mute("<17b, 18b..49b, 50b..")
tagged("wet").send("verb", 0.35); tagged("low").send("glue", 0.35)
